Pernod Ricard Sales Decline Partially Offset by India Market

Pernod Ricard reported a decline in first-quarter sales, which was less severe than anticipated. The company's performance was partially supported by strength observed in the Indian market. While cautious optimism was expressed regarding China, the overall sales figures indicated a downturn.
